description: Pre-money SAFE (YC 2013) with option pool top-up. Denominator per YC 2013 'Company Capitalization' includes the new pool increase, so the SAFE holder is not diluted by the pool.
derivation: Baseline: 10M common (no existing pool). Pre-money = $10M, new money = $2M. PPS = 10M/10M = $1.00. Projected pool top-up for pre-money-SAFE denom (interim=baseline=10M, newMoneyShares=2M, target 10%): add = (0.10 × (10M + 2M) − 0) / (1 − 0.10) = 1,333,334 (ceil). Pre-money SAFE cap denom = 10M + 1,333,334 = 11,333,334. Pre-money SAFE cap price = 10M / 11,333,334 = 0.882353. SAFE shares = 1M / 0.882353 = 1,133,333 (floor). After conversion, pool top-up is re-solved with interim = 10M + 1,133,333 = 11,133,333 → pool shares = ceil((0.10 × (11,133,333 + 2,000,000) − 0) / 0.90) = 1,459,260 (iterates). New-money shares = 2M / 1.00 = 2,000,000. Final FD = 10,000,000 + 1,133,333 + 1,459,260 + 2,000,000 = 14,592,593.
